Optional offline copy of Leaflet 1.9.4 (last-resort fallback).

The site loads Leaflet from public CDNs first. If you want maps to also
work when those CDNs are blocked or you are offline, download Leaflet
1.9.4 from https://leafletjs.com/download.html and copy these files here:

    leaflet.js
    leaflet.css
    images/layers.png
    images/layers-2x.png
    images/marker-icon.png
    images/marker-icon-2x.png
    images/marker-shadow.png

(The folder structure inside the zip's "dist" folder is what you want.)
Map TILES (the actual street/satellite pictures) still need internet.
